covers.declared: The ratcheting dead-code check and twelve retirements under it, 5,694 source lines, each with a recorded RETIREMENT_REVIEW verdict. The ratchet fell 17 -> 5.
covers.uncovered: Five orphans remain, 3,368 lines, each held for a named reason. Three are the owner's CE-MCP judgement (sandbox-executor.ts, memory-migration-manager.ts, memory-rollback-manager.ts). aggregator-endpoint-map.ts is the subject of a live CI workflow and a separate PRD decision. adr-planning-task-integration.ts is blocked on ADR-020 Phase 5, which is unchecked and standing -- superseding it is a ratification act. Also uncovered: 120 exported symbols with zero references, and smart_score, which is still advertised and returns a deprecation notice.

$comment: The check is mutation-verified in three directions: adding an orphan to src/ raises the count and exits 1; wiring an orphan into src/index.ts lowers it and prints the ratchet instruction; hiding src/index.ts aborts with exit 2 rather than reporting a clean repository, because a check that silently scans nothing is the failure this milestone keeps finding in the code it is cleaning up. That second mutation earned its place immediately -- it did NOT move the count on the first run, which exposed a missing edge shape in my own graph builder: bare side-effect imports (`import './x.js';`, no bindings) were not matched, so any module reached only that way would have been reported dead. A graph that misses an edge shape reports live code as dead, and deletion is the one error here that a revert does not always undo. Fixed before the script landed; the census reading is unchanged at 17/9,062 because no such import existed. Note the census held at 17 files / 9,062 lines while src/ itself fell from 183 files to 172 across this milestone: the work so far removed reachable code and dead methods inside live files, not whole orphans. 14 of the 17 have a test suite and no caller -- their tests pass against code nothing runs, which reads as coverage and is not. UPDATE 2026-08-29: retiring bootstrap-task-integration.ts and llm-artifact-detector.ts required disposing of two open v3.0 issues first, and one of them was not what it claimed. #740 asked to merge `feature/mcp-tasks-integration`; that branch was merged by PR #363 on 2025-12-17, FOUR MONTHS BEFORE #740 was created on 2026-04-21 by scripts/create-github-issues.sh. The branch was absent from origin because it had been deleted after merging, not because the work was outstanding. Closed as completed, not obsolete. That merge is also where all four *-task-integration modules came from, which is why two of them are dead: the code landed and was never wired up. The ADR check changed the outcome: ADR-020's Phase 2 item 'Wrap BootstrapValidationLoop.run() as a Task' was superseded by ADR-025, so bootstrap-task-integration.ts could be retired, but Phase 5's 'Wrap 7-phase planning workflow as a Task' is unchecked and standing, so adr-planning-task-integration.ts was NOT deleted despite being approved in the batch. Deleting it would be implementing around an accepted decision; superseding the item is the owner's ratification act.
